formal_statement: ∃ L : Submodule (ZMod 5) (Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ZMod 5), Module.finrank (ZMod 5) L = 4 ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 3) => (1 : ZMod 5) + t (i, j)) = 6
plain_statement: Over the field with 5 elements there is a 4-dimensional linear space L of 3 x 3 matrices such that for every t in L the permanent of the matrix with entries 1 + t(i, j) equals 6, the permanent of the all-ones matrix. The same question over the complex numbers has the checked answer: such spaces have dimension at most 3. Conjecture.
title: Probe: over the field with 5 elements, a four-dimensional space of 3 x 3 matrices keeps the permanent of the all-ones matrix plus it at 6
